text.bouncemod.screen.title: Squash Mod Settings
text.bouncemod.bpm.tooltip: Beats per minute — how fast entities squash.
text.bouncemod.amplitude.tooltip: How strong the squash is. 0 = off, 2 = extreme.
text.bouncemod.alternating.tooltip: Neighbouring entities squash in opposite phase.
text.bouncemod.volume.tooltip: Volume of the bounce music (0 to 1).
text.bouncemod.range.tooltip: Max distance for entities to squash.
text.bouncemod.all.tooltip: If on, every living entity squashes regardless of the categories above.
